issues.title: Food Bank Vietnam marks decade of impact, unveils new food security roadmap
issues.title_en: Food Bank Vietnam marks decade of impact, unveils new food security roadmap
issues.summary: Marking a decade of community impact on October 10, Food Bank Vietnam unveiled a forward-looking national roadmap at the Vietnam Food System Summit 2026, successfully pivoting its core mission from emergency food relief toward circular economy solutions and long-term systemic food security.

issues.title: Egypt Turns 25 Years of Gaucher Care Into a Global Rare-Disease Asset
issues.title_en: Egypt Turns 25 Years of Gaucher Care Into a Global Rare-Disease Asset
issues.summary: Egypt has built one of the world’s most significant long-term clinical records on type 3 Gaucher disease while sustaining a treatment-access model that has operated for more than a quarter of a century.
